name: Everyone has a million problems until they lose their health

lines.ref:
Everyone has a million problems until
they lose their health. Then they have
only one. Health is the real luxury.
Stay grateful

shots.brief: drinking coffee or tea at a desk, looking contemplative (ref: A healthcare worker in blue scrubs sits at an office desk with a keyboard, drinking from a paper cup and looking around thoughtfully.; tripod)

audit.notes: This format pairs a grounding philosophical quote about health/gratitude with calm, reflective b-roll. Any quiet lifestyle clip—such as drinking coffee at home, working at a desk, or looking out a subway window—will work seamlessly.
audit.summary: A healthcare professional in blue scrubs sips a warm drink at her desk while reflective text reminds viewers that health is the ultimate luxury.
